# 🧠 Peer Review – Milestone 3: RAG Pipeline

> Reviewer: **<Your Name>**  
> Team Reviewed: **<Team Name>**  
> Deliverable Reviewed: ☐ Presentation ☐ Technical Report (select one or both)  
> Date: **<MM/DD/YYYY>**

---

## 1️⃣ Overall Impression
**Describe your overall impression of the RAG pipeline.**  
- What stood out to you the most?  
- Did the team clearly explain how retrieval and generation were connected?  
- Was the workflow easy to follow?

> _Your response:_

---

## 2️⃣ Pipeline Design & Technical Depth
**Assess the clarity and robustness of the pipeline design.**  
- Are all major components (data ingestion, embeddings, vector store, retriever, generator) well explained?  
- Did the team justify their design decisions (e.g., model choice, vector DB, query strategy)?  
- Is the diagram accurate and informative?

> _Your response:_

---

## 3️⃣ Query Transformation & Prompt Engineering
**Evaluate how well the team handled query improvement and prompt design.**  
- Did they use meaningful transformation techniques (e.g., multi-query, fusion, decomposition)?  
- Were prompt templates clear, structured, and contextually relevant?  
- Did they reflect on prompt iteration or debugging?

> _Your response:_

---

## 4️⃣ Demonstration & LangSmith Trace
**Assess the walkthrough and trace clarity.**  
- Was the example query realistic and well chosen?  
- Did the LangSmith (or equivalent) trace clearly show retrieval and generation steps?  
- Did the team interpret model behavior and limitations effectively?

> _Your response:_

---

## 5️⃣ Reflection & Lessons Learned
**Evaluate the reflection and next steps.**  
- Did the team discuss limitations (e.g., hallucinations, latency, noisy retrievals)?  
- Did they identify specific improvements (e.g., rerankers, hybrid retrieval)?  
- Were insights meaningful and grounded in their experience?

> _Your response:_

---

## 6️⃣ Presentation Quality (if applicable)
**Rate the quality of the presentation.**
- Clarity and structure of slides (≤ 6 slides)?  
- Equal participation from members?  
- Time management (≤ 8 min + 2 min Q&A)?  
- Visual design and flow?

> _Your response:_

---

## 7️⃣ Technical Report Quality (if applicable)
**Rate the quality of the written report.**
- Is it concise (500–800 words) and well structured?  
- Are diagrams, examples, and references clear?  
- Does it demonstrate understanding and originality?

> _Your response:_

---

## 8️⃣ Constructive Feedback & Suggestions
**Provide 2–3 specific suggestions for improvement.**  
(Think: clarity, evaluation, usability, reproducibility, design choices.)

> _Your response:_

---
